attempts.response_text:
From: Nadia Fennimore
To: Ruth Calloway
Date: 2025-06-12
Subject: Vantorre: who signs

Ruth,

Mateo Quiroga, Head of Procurement, is the decision maker for the MSA at Vantorre Group. Please route the decision questions to him, rather than back through the dock supervisors. They can tell us why door 6 keeps getting double-booked; they cannot settle the MSA. Apparently those are different qualifications.

Mateo asked for one clean copy with the outstanding questions grouped together. I am sending June the marked-up version this afternoon, including his note about keeping the Pemberline Dock product name consistent throughout. The attachment currently manages three variations, which is an achievement nobody requested.

The operations team also sent the morning receiving report. Two appointments appeared under the wrong shift after a dispatcher changed the arrival window. I will handle that separately so the contract email does not become a support ticket with legal stationery.

Once June has the clean copy ready, I will send it to Mateo and copy you.

> From: Ruth Calloway
> To: Nadia Fennimore
> Date: 2025-06-11
> Subject: Re: Vantorre: who signs
>
> Who is making the MSA decision at Vantorre Group? The forwarded chain has procurement comments mixed in with receiving-team questions, and I would rather not send another reply-all asking the loading dock to interpret contract language.
